title: Hokkaido Gals Are Super Adorable!
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Tsubasa Shiki moves from Tokyo to Kitami, Hokkaido, where outgoing gal Minami Fuyuki takes him under her wing and teases him, and reserved Sayuri Akino becomes a friend. He slowly realizes he has fallen for Minami; the series ends with them married and raising a daughter. Seven Seas publishes 2-in-1 omnibuses from 2025 and Manga Plus runs it free; rating to verify.
life_message: It holds up warmth, local belonging and growing into a committed love.
